in_hebrew.name: יֵשׁ__
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יֵשׁ (Yeš) is a short form of the Hebrew name יְהוֹשׁוּעַ (Yehoshua'), which means 'God is salvation'. The name Jes is a modern English variant.

in_greek.name: Ιεσσα__
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the name Jes is Ιεσσα (Iessā), which may be derived from the Hebrew name יֵשׁ (Yeš), meaning 'God is salvation'. However, there is no clear biblical reference to a person named Jes in Greek.

in_latin.name: Iess__
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Jes is Iessus, which is a variant of the Greek form Ιεσσα (Iessā). It is not directly related to the Hebrew name יֵשׁ (Yeš).
